title: From Dreams to Paper
paras: People have written down dreams for thousands of years. In ancient Egypt, some dream books connected dream images with possible future events. However, these books were not personal diaries. [[unlike|Unlike]] a private notebook, they offered meanings that different readers could apply to their own dreams. Few people had [[access|access]] to written books, so recording dreams was not an everyday practice.

As paper became cheaper and more people learned to write, private dream notebooks became easier to keep. By the nineteenth century, a person with a modest [[income|income]] could buy a small notebook. An entry might describe a [[nightmare|nightmare]] about walking [[outdoors|outdoors]] wearing only [[underwear|underwear]]. Another might record a dream of a bitter [[argument|argument]] with a friend. The writer could feel [[ashamed|ashamed]] on waking, although the quarrel had never happened. Such details made each notebook deeply personal.

Later, dream recording became part of the study of the mind. Instead of asking only what a dream predicted, writers asked how it related to daily life. Today, someone who has just installed [[solar|solar]] panels might dream about a roof covered in them. A friend might do the writer a [[favour|favour]] by listening and noticing repeated events. A notebook beside the bed still serves a simple purpose: catching a strange experience before it disappears.
zh: 几千年来，人们一直在记录梦境。在古埃及，一些解梦书把梦中的景象与未来可能发生的事情联系起来。不过，这些书并不是个人日记。与私人笔记本不同，它们提供了一些解释，不同的读者可以用这些解释来理解自己的梦。当时很少有人有机会阅读书籍，因此记录梦境并不是日常习惯。
随着纸张变得更便宜，学会写字的人越来越多，记私人梦境笔记也变得更容易。到了十九世纪，收入不高的人也能买一本小笔记本。其中一篇可能描述这样一个噩梦：自己只穿着内衣走在户外。另一篇可能记录梦中与朋友激烈争吵的情景。醒来时，记录者也许会感到羞愧，尽管这场争吵从未真正发生。这些细节使每本笔记都带有鲜明的个人色彩。
后来，记录梦境成为研究心理活动的一部分。记录者不再只问梦预示着什么，也开始思考它与日常生活有什么联系。如今，刚安装了太阳能板的人可能会梦见铺满太阳能板的屋顶。朋友可以帮个忙，听记录者讲述，并留意反复出现的事件。床边的一本笔记本仍发挥着一个简单的作用：在一段奇特的经历消失之前，把它留住。

q.s: Ancient Egyptian dream books could provide interpretations for more than one reader.
q.why: 第一段说不同读者可用书中解释理解自己的梦。

q.s: Keeping a private dream notebook became harder as paper prices fell.
q.why: 第二段说纸张变便宜使记录梦境更容易。

q.s: Modern dream writers usually share their notebooks with family members.
q.why: 文章未说明现代记录者是否常与家人分享笔记。
